fields.sourceTitle: Exact CC18 title preserved without rewriting.
fields.originalTitleJa: Authoritative Japanese title when a verifiable source provides it; null when unavailable.
fields.translatedTitleZhTw: Faithful Traditional Chinese translation of originalTitleJa; null when the original title is unavailable.
fields.title: Traditional Chinese reader-facing H1 grounded first in the CC18 source title and source tags, then completed by one editorial judgment.
fields.seoTitle: Traditional Chinese search title containing the catalog number, performer when known, one primary source-grounded adult topic and a useful differentiating judgment.
fields.socialTitle: Short hook for Open Graph and short-video surfaces; it may be more conversational but cannot add unsupported identity facts.
fields.titleSignals: Two to four short, source-grounded entities or concepts used to construct and audit all generated titles.
fields.coreSourceConcept: One short phrase extracted from the source title, series or synopsis that best distinguishes the work's premise; it outranks generic tag popularity.
fields.titleVersion: Positive integer incremented when the title strategy or generated title set is materially revised.

tag_boundaries.source_tags: Exact CC18 labels. They are source records and may be quoted or normalized only through the mapping layer.
tag_boundaries.canonical_tags: Site-wide stable categories selected only through approved deterministic mappings or taxonomy rules.
tag_boundaries.editorial_tags: Interpretive review lenses generated by the editor; they must never be represented as CC18 facts or silently promoted to canonical tags.
